descriptionChirho: To engage in sexual immorality or fornication, covering all grammatical forms of the verb porneuō. All four clusters express the identical lexical meaning — illicit sexual conduct — differing only in tense, mood, and person (aorist indicative/participle, aorist infinitive, present subjunctive, present participle). Arabic consistently renders زَنَى (zanā, 'commit adultery/fornication'), Korean uses 음행하다 (eumhaenghada, 'commit sexual immorality'), Hindi uses व्यभिचार करना (vyabhichār karnā, 'commit adultery'), Swahili uses -zini (fornicate) and uasherati (immorality), and Spanish uses fornicar/fornicar throughout. No semantic distinction warrants separate senses.
